name: Microgrid feeder energization readiness gate
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Checks the documented prerequisites before connecting the assigned feeder in a restoration stage.
description: Checks the documented prerequisites before connecting the assigned feeder in a restoration stage. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Feeder status and permits” at the input and “Feeder connection permission” at the output. A control permissive does not prove field isolation removed correctly.
